items.title: Securely exposing Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime delivers a secure serverless environment to deploy AI agents and tools at scale. When you start talking to your agent, the runtime launches a dedicated isolated session that runs in its own dedicated microVM with a completely sandboxed CPU, memory, and filesystem allocation.
